1.consolidated_definition: Pasar un rato estando calmado, tranquilo o relajado. El Pretexto es el primer Culinary Farm Lodge en Puerto Rico para desconectarse, chilear, mimarse y compartir con gente linda.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To spend time in a calm, tranquil, or relaxed state. El Pretexto is the first Culinary Farm Lodge in Puerto Rico for disconnecting, socializing, and sharing with lovely people.
